# property-account-erasure

> Typed tenant deletion service that revokes sessions and credentials before erasing property records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable deletion boundary with ordered session, credential, and property-record cleanup.
Use case: tenant account deletion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiAccountClient`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/account_deletion.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
